knownGaps.summary: Content Mapper semantic, protocol, lifecycle, performance and real-project obligations are not joined to one exact candidate.
knownGaps.exitCondition: Every contentMapper obligation has exact positive, negative, boundary, malformed-edit and repair receipts for one candidate source.

knownGaps.summary: Five case names are not joined to exact diagnostics, ranges, edits, output, ordering and exit packets.
knownGaps.exitCondition: Every source combination has executable positive, negative, boundary, malformed-edit and repair selectors with receipt identity.

knownGaps.summary: No single exact candidate has native, Bun, WSL2 and editor evidence for every required product row.
knownGaps.exitCondition: One candidate SHA produces admitted receipts for every requiredRows entry.

knownGaps.summary: The all-rule registry is not exact-partitioned by language, fix ownership and five-case evidence.
knownGaps.exitCondition: The generated manifest consumes the complete Patina registry and rejects missing or duplicate rule obligations.

knownGaps.summary: Vue 3.6 pins and current stability tiers do not yet match the v1 target channel.
knownGaps.exitCondition: One canonical Vue baseline and #13016 channel metadata agree across package peers, docs and release workflows.

knownGaps.summary: Four editors run TS-45 while Vim and Emacs run configuration-only lanes; WSL2 is not full editor conformance.
knownGaps.exitCondition: Each advertised editor has an explicitly scoped required scenario and exact candidate receipt without order normalization.

semantic.requirement: Vue 2.7 host and current Vue 3 SFC diagnostics remain exact.
Script setup bindings, macros and public local types retain authored diagnostics.
Options API instance bindings and diagnostics retain source ownership.
Generic components preserve declared inference, fallthrough and authored errors.
Slot declarations, destructuring and payload diagnostics are neither hidden nor repeated.
Declared, open and dynamic emit payloads retain their exact contracts.
Model props and update events retain value and listener diagnostics.
Ignore, skip and expect directives suppress only their authored diagnostic owners.
CSS module options and template access retain exact diagnostics.
Native attributes and events remain distinct from component props and emits.
Path, import and template aliases resolve through the opened project.
Imported SFC packages and declarations preserve importer-scoped resolution.
Referenced projects are checked once without dropping cross-project diagnostics.
Nuxt-generated aliases and ambient types participate in the mapper project.
An SFC transform failure never hides diagnostics from another project file.
JSX and TSX embedded in a Vue SFC retain exact script and template diagnostics.

diagnostics.requirement: Codes, categories, messages, files, authored spans, ordering and exit status are exact.
Related information retains its authored file and range without generated leakage.
Suppression is selected by authored ownership and never widens to a generated range.
Generated helpers and virtual files never replace source diagnostics.

lifecycle.requirement: Every file and overlay transition belongs to one monotonic project revision.

boundaryExamples.reason: TSRX is a pinned differential oracle, not a Content Mapper input claim.
The Svelte proof of concept is compiler boundary evidence and remains unsupported input.
The Astro proof of concept is compiler boundary evidence and remains unsupported input.

editors.testedBaseline: Zed 1.27.0 GUI host plus protocol TS-45

packet.passedContract: source and candidate packet hashes must be identical

unsupported.reason: Vapor starts at Vue 3.6; Vue 2.7 integration retains the host VDOM compiler.
The bundled TypeScript provider is glibc-only; musl remains a Node 24 lane.
The current packed musl qualification runs Node 24 only.
WSL2 qualifies the typechecker and LSP server, not every shipped editor host.
Older legacy dialect compatibility is not a v1 support claim.
These adapters are deferred beyond v1.
